counts_with_distinct_units.note: The eight raw members in two invalid reviewer control envelopes never reached admission and are excluded from the 202 proposals. Unparseable payloads do not have a reliable proposal-count denominator.

steps: Read immutable cohort freeze and preregistration; verify contract digest.
Read only freeze-bound trajectory/stage/scout artifacts and scout/reviewer request/results, verifying every exact-byte hash.
Independently classify retained envelopes with strict duplicate-key rejection and compare to actual parser/gate receipts.
Reconcile all gate proposal indexes to disjoint admitted/rejected indexes; separate previous-stage revalidation.
Aggregate proposal occurrences, role/domain/stage counts and duplicates; inspect expected digest field presence without running an oracle.
Re-read all 201 bound inputs immediately before writing this artifact; every hash remained unchanged.

findings.statement: 34 scout calls yielded 24 accepted envelopes containing 91 gate-submitted proposals: 54 admitted, 20 wrong expectations, and 17 duplicates. Ten whole envelopes were rejected before individual admission.

42 reviewer calls yielded 36 accepted envelopes containing 111 gate-submitted proposals: 67 admitted, 43 wrong expectations, and one duplicate. Four JSON syntax errors and two invalid notes fields excluded six entire reviewer envelopes.

Graph scouts admitted 7 of 24 submitted proposals across seven attempted stages; calendar scouts admitted 47 of 67 across ten stages. All four graph stage-2 proposals that reached admission were public duplicates; three other graph stage-2 scout envelopes were unparseable. Domain difficulty and artifact-format differences are not isolated by these descriptive counts.

All 81 individual rejections were wrong expectation (63) or duplicate input (18). No individual case-schema, unsupported-requirement, oracle input-domain, stage-cap, or bounded-JSON rejection occurred among these gate submissions. Seventeen duplicate rejections matched public cases and one matched a previous generated probe.

Graph reviewer proposals with non-null digest strings were admitted 11/41 and rejected for wrong expectation 30/41; those without digest strings were admitted 23/30, rejected for wrong expectation 6/30, and duplicated 1/30. Every one of the 24 parseable graph scout proposals omitted non-null digest strings.

The evidence format may conflate test-design quality with the ability to supply complete exact outputs. The association does not establish that hashes caused rejection: admission receipts reject the whole expected value without exposing corrected answers, and other fields may differ. No explicit hash-avoidance statement, placeholder digest, malformed-length digest, or contradiction against an exact matching trusted public command prefix was found in the independent read-only check.

Admission validates syntax/domain and exact expected outputs; it does not establish defect-detection strength, useful novelty beyond input identity, candidate correctness, or a benefit of the swarm approach. Those conclusions require the separately audited candidate/fault-bank evidence.

examples.observation: Requires exact JSON outputs and states that wrong labels are rejected without correction.

Nine hash-bearing reviewer proposal occurrences across three rounds were rejected as wrong expectations. The latter two rounds repeated the same three complete proposals; they are repeated submissions, not six distinct tests.
Proposals zero and one were admitted with concrete digest expectations, so the format did not prevent all cache/provenance tests.

hash_output_observation.next_preregistered_comparison: Compare exact full-output proposals with a constrained, independently validated relational-assertion format or a sandboxed calculation tool, while keeping test budgets and oracle access matched. This is a proposed future contract change; no current-study output was repaired or relabeled.

independent_read_only_review.limitations: No private receipts, fault grades, oracle recomputation, candidate execution or files changed.
independent_read_only_review.scope: Hash-output interpretation and graph scout parser/admission counts

scope.observations: Frozen public scout/reviewer request envelopes and retained oracle-admission receipts only.

unit_definitions.admitted_proposals: New admitted proposal occurrences at their submission stage; previous-stage revalidation is excluded.
unit_definitions.calls: Physical scout/reviewer dispatch occurrences, each bound to the pre-private cohort freeze.
unit_definitions.hash_bearing: At least one non-null string under an expected digest or digests field; presence is an observable payload feature, not evidence that a rejection was caused by an incorrect hash.
unit_definitions.parsed_batches: Envelopes accepted by the actual scout/controller parser; reviewer envelopes include control fields as well as probes. Four valid reviewer envelopes proposed zero tests.
unit_definitions.parsed_proposals: Individual proposal occurrences submitted to the oracle-admission gate from accepted envelopes. Repeated proposals count again; this is not a count of independent cases.
unit_definitions.rejected_proposals: Individual proposal occurrences rejected by an admission receipt. Whole envelope failures are separate and are never added to this count.
unit_definitions.revalidation: Previously admitted cases checked against the next milestone oracle contract; 53 cases in seven receipts, all retained, zero rejected or retired. These are not 53 new tests.
unit_definitions.unparseable_or_controller_rejected_envel: Whole call payloads excluded before individual admission. Ten scouts: nine syntax errors and one duplicate JSON member. Six reviewers: four syntax errors and two valid-JSON envelopes whose notes field was a list instead of a string.
